context: THE GREEN MARKET SAFE ROBBED&On Saturday evening, after the closure of the supermarket Le Marché Vert, the central cash register ($11,480 in cash) disappeared from the manager’s office between 8:50 p.m. and 9:15 p.m. The safe was opened with the correct code, no break-in. The store was closed to the public since 8:30 p.m., but ten people (staff or suppliers) were still on site. The thief left through the back door with the money in a bag.
facts: Closed to the public: 8:30 p.m. &It has been raining since 8:45 p.m. &Badge no. 7 used on the office door at 8:48 p.m. &Parking lot camera cut off at 8:52 p.m. &A man is filmed leaving through the back door at 9:04 p.m. with a blue sports bag &The gate of the delivery platform was slammed shut around 9:00 p.m.

context: THE ASSAULT IN THE FITZONE GYM&On Thursday evening, 10:10 p.m., the housekeeper found the owner of the FitZone gym, Bruno Adler (52 years old), unconscious at the foot of the squat rack: he had been hit by a dumbbell to the head. Hospitalized but stable, he only remembers a sweet smell and a silhouette in the mirror, just before the blow. The room closed at 10 p.m. and ten people (subscribers and employees) were still in the building between 9:30 p.m. and 10 p.m. The attacker left, letting the emergency door alarm go off for a few seconds.
facts: Closing: 10:00 p.m. &Last exit badge recorded: 9:48 p.m.&Emergency door alarm triggered at 9:55 p.m. (a few seconds)&5 kg dumbbell, handle wiped and white coat (magnesia) on the floor, in the hallway of the vestiaires <The victim remembers a sweet smell (perfume)

context: THE THEFT OF EXAM SUBJECTS, JEAN-JAURÈS SCHOOL&On Thursday, the subjects from the final mathematics test for ninth grade classes disappeared from the secretariat’s vault between 5:30 p.m. and 7:30 p.m. The chest was opened with the key, without breaking in. Someone then photocopied the subjects, which are already circulating on a student messaging group. The director, Mrs. Lacombe, demands the culprit before the next day’s exam at 8 a.m. Ten adults from the institution were still present after the end of classes.
facts: End of classes: 5:30 p.m. &Secretariat locked at 5:45 p.m. &Badge no. 12 (staff) used on the door to corridor B at 6:42 p.m. &The photocopier in the corridor printed 24 pages at 6:50 p.m. &A coffee stain on the first page of the photocopy and a student saw a blue vest silhouette in the courtyard&Thewindow in corridor B remained ajar

context: THE FIRE IN THE GUARD’S CABIN, FORÊT DE BRÉVANE&Saturday evening around 7:30 p.m., the hut of the forest ranger Roger Vasseur caught fire in the heart of the forest of Brévane. The guard, absent, found an empty petrol can ten meters from the ruins and a boot print. The fire destroyed his logging records: he had been investigating illegal logging for months. At that time, the forest was frequented by hunters, loggers, walkers and beekeepers.

context: THE DESECRATION OF DELACROIX’S TOMB&During the night from Tuesday to Wednesday, the slab of the Delacroix family’s tomb in Saint-Louis cemetery was moved and the gold medallion of the late Éléonore Delacroix disappeared. The guard discovered the facts at 7:15 a.m. on Wednesday. The gate had been closed since 6 p.m. and its lock is intact. The heirs of the family have been arguing for years. Ten people related to the cemetery or the family must be questioned.
facts: Gate closed at 6:00 p.m., lock intact and 80 kg door moved with a steel lever and red clay door in aisle 6. &Entrance camera out of service since Tuesday at 3 p.m. &A dog barked around 12:30 a.m. at a nearby climbing site on the wall on the street side of Moulin&Brume épaisse all night.

context: THE ROBBERY OF "THE LADY WITH THE GREEN HAT"&On Friday evening, during the night opening of the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Villeneuve, the painting "The Lady with the Green Hat" (oil on canvas from 1887, estimated at 2.4 million euros) disappeared from room 4 between 9:15 p.m. and 9:40 p.m. The empty frame was found in the cleaning room in the west corridor. About 120 guests were present. The thief knew the staff’s alarm code and the floor plan.
facts: Alarm in room 4 deactivated with a personnel code at 9:14 p.m. &90-second power outage at 9:32 p.m. &Window opened with a key, without any glass breakage &Empty frame found in the cleaning room, West&a waitress saw a man in a long gray coat take the service staircase and a coat was picked up from the cloakroom without a ticket at 9:40 p.m.

context: THE STOLEN SUITCASE FROM VILLENEUVE STATION&Monday evening, the jeweler Salomon Weil dropped off at 4:50 p.m. a gray suitcase containing €60,000 in jewelry in locker no. 318. At 5:40 p.m., he finds the empty locker on his way back. The suitcase was found empty at 6:05 p.m. in a trash bin on platform 3. Between 5:00 p.m. and 5:40 p.m., ten people were working or waiting around the central hall and the locker corridor.
facts: Detention ticket no. 318 issued at 4:50 p.m. &Locker opened with the correct code, no break-in & The camera in the detention center hallway does not film the locker entrance & Anchor at the microphone at 5:25 p.m. (train from 5:42 p.m., delayed by 12 minutes)&A man with an orange backpack was seen in the hall&Valise found at 6:05 p.m. in a trash bin on platform 3.

context: THE UNEASE OF THE CRITIC AT THE BISTRO DES HALLES&Sunday evening, at 9:20 p.m., the gastronomic critic Jean-Marc Delaunay collapsed at table 7 of the Bistrot des Halles. The analyses reveal a powerful sleeping pill in his glass of red wine (a Saint-Émilion). The previous month, he had published a murderous review of the restaurant. Ten people were able to approach his glass between 8:50 p.m. and 9:15 p.m.
facts: Bottle opened at table 7 at 8:50 p.m., glass filled at 8:52 p.m. &A non-staff person entered the kitchen at 8:58 p.m. &Dessert (tarte tatin) Was served at 9:10 p.m. &White powder found on the briefcase and the room camera did not record the phone &One waiter in a black apron was seen leaning over table 7
